recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No core source follow-up is needed for FHIR-6954 unless a separate tracker asks to clean up unrelated removed-resource references or examples.
issue_request: FHIR-6954 was a Published/Persuasive with Modification DSTU1 Structured Documents change request asking whether DocumentManifest.author identified authors of the documents in the set or the author of the DocumentManifest. The resolution was to clarify that this is who authored the manifest.
initial_application: The historical git-svn commit effcc548e4472b26ada0e12101f498c3ca0d3d89, matching Jira's SVN revision 6193 comment, changed source/documentmanifest/documentmanifest-spreadsheet.xml from document-oriented wording to 'Who and/or what authored the manifest' and a definition about creating the manifest and adding documents to it. Current retained release-history artifacts for R2/R3/R4/R4B show 'manifest' or 'DocumentManifest' wording for DocumentManifest.author.
additional_context: DocumentManifest is not an active current-build resource: source/fhir.ini comments out documentmanifest in the active resource work-group list, records it as dropped, and maps DocumentManifest to List. source/history.html lists DocumentManifest as removed after R4B with List as the replacement. The current replacement author-like field, List.source, identifies who decided the list contents rather than authors of referenced documents. Jira searches found no related DocumentManifest.author issue besides FHIR-6954, and Zulip/Confluence searches found no conflicting community evidence.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. No current source edit is needed because the historical clarification is already reflected where DocumentManifest is retained as history, and there is no active DocumentManifest.author definition in the current build.
